title: Qualify provider ownership and shutdown deadline feasibility
question: Qualify provider ownership and shutdown deadline feasibility for the selected Typer-first logging target?
method: Pinned-source inspection and isolated synthetic native probes; retain original failures and separate bounded library evidence from application/provider acceptance.
conclusion: Host/local ownership and final collection exercised; actual loopback transport timeout fails bounded request. SDK flush10ms took about250ms, disproving naive hard-deadline preemption. Total graceful application shutdown remains unestablished.
